Payslip Totals per Item and Employee

The Payslip Totals Per Item and Employee form configures detailed payroll reports.

Set parameters to analyze payroll items broken down by employee and category.

Description

Enter an optional description for this report, such as 'Annual Payroll Analysis' or 'Department Payroll Breakdown'.

Periods

Define the reporting periods for comparison. You can add multiple periods to compare payroll data across different time frames.
